# Benchmark-layer requirements — installed AFTER the M0 smoke passes and only
# into the `wheat599` env. These pull the model stacks referenced in
# configs/core.yaml. The TabPFN *weights* are still not vendored here; they are
# fetched separately and SHA-256-verified before any run.
#
# Torch: pick a build matching the host CUDA. The dev box has an RTX 5090 D
# (CUDA 13.x capable). Install the matching wheel from pytorch.org first, e.g.:
#   pip install torch==2.9.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130
# then install the rest below.
#
# TabPFN is pinned to the version whose ModelVersion.V3_5 checkpoint is used
# (9.2.0 per the lead's read of the HF checkpoint header).
torch==2.9.0
tabpfn==9.2.0

# rtdl-revisiting-models — Apache-2.0 CONFIRMED 2026-10-29 (lead's GitHub + PyPI
# dist-info check; the earlier 404 was a wrong path). Pin the exact version at
# freeze; the FT-Transformer baseline depends on it.
rtdl-revisiting-models

# TabM (yandex-research/tabm), Apache-2.0.
tabm
